fields.title: Ku Kwagala Katonda
fields.subtitle: De Diligendo Deo
fields.description: Ku Kwagala Katonda kye kitabo kya Bernard of Clairvaux ekitono naye ekikulu ennyo, ekinnyonnyola lwaki era mu ngeri ki gye tusaanidde okwagala Katonda. Ng’awandiika mu kyasa eky’ekkumi n’ebibiri, Bernard addamu nti twagala Katonda olw’oyo gw’ali n’olw’ebyo byonna by’atuwadde — era alaga emmeeme bw’eyambuka mu mitendera ena egy’okwagala: okuva ku kweyagala ggwe wekka, okutuuka ku kwagala Katonda ku lwaffe ffekka, ate ku kwagala Katonda ku lwa Katonda yennyini, era ku nkomerero ku kweyagala ffe ffennyini ku lwa Katonda yekka. Kya kisa, kinoonyereza mu mutima, era kimpi; kiriisizza okwagala kw’Abakristaayo okumala emyaka lunaana.

qa.question: Ku Kwagala Katonda kyogera ku ki?
qa.answer: Kye kitabo kya Bernard of Clairvaux ekitono naye ekikulu ennyo, ekinnyonnyola lwaki era mu ngeri ki gye tusaanidde okwagala Katonda. Ng’awandiika mu kyasa eky’ekkumi n’ebibiri, Bernard addamu ekibuuzo kya lwaki Katonda asaanidde okwagalibwa ng’agamba nti: olw’oyo gw’ali n’olw’ebyo byonna by’atuwadde — era ekibuuzo kya kumeka, n’okuddamu kwe okwamanyika ennyo, nti ekigero ky’okwagala Katonda kwe kumwagala awatali kigero. Oluvannyuma alaga emmeeme bw’eyambuka mu mitendera gy’okwagala.

qa.question: Bernard of Clairvaux yali ani?
qa.answer: Yali abbot Omufalansa mu kyasa eky’ekkumi n’ebibiri, eyatandikawo ekkomera ly’abamonaki e Clairvaux, era omu ku bantu abaasinga okuba n’obuyinza mu kkanisa ey’omu mirembe egy’edda — omuzzi w’obuggya, omubuulizi, era omuntu eyabeeranga mu kukwatagana okw’omunda ne Katonda, era okwagala kwe okw’ebbugumu kwamufunyisa erinnya ‘omusomesa ow’omubisi gw’enjuki.’ Ku Kwagala Katonda kye kimu ku bitabo bye ebisinga okumanyika, era kya muwendo mu bitabo by’obulamu obw’omwoyo obw’Ekikristaayo.

qa.question: Bernard addamu atya ekibuuzo kya lwaki tusaanidde okwagala Katonda?
qa.answer: Nti Katonda asaanidde okwagalibwa ku lulwe yennyini, olw’oyo gw’ali, era nti tumubanjibwa okwagala olw’ebyo byonna by’atuwadde — okusooka ebirabo eby’okutondebwa n’obulamu, era okusinga byonna, ekirabo kye yennyini mu kununulibwa. Katonda ye yasooka okutwagala n’awaayo obulamu bwe ku lwaffe; ekyokuddamu kyokka ekisaanidde kwe kumwagala naffe, era okumwagala kubanga asaanira okwagalibwa, so si olw’ebirungi by’atuwa byokka.

qa.question: Bernard ategeeza ki bw’agamba okwagala Katonda ‘awatali kigero’?
qa.answer: Bwe yabuuzibwa ekigero ky’okwagala Katonda kye kirina okuba, Bernard yaddamu nti ekigero kwe kwagala awatali kigero — kwe kugamba, tewali kkomo okwagala Katonda we kutuuka ne kuba kungi okusukkiridde. Olw’okuba okwagala kwa Katonda yennyini n’obukulu bwe tebirina nkomerero, okwagala kwe tumubanjibwa tekulina kkomo lya waggulu; buli kiseera tusaanidde okumwagala okusingawo, so tetusalawo nti tumwagadde ekimala.

qa.question: ‘Emitendera gy’okwagala’ Bernard gy’ayogerako gye giruwa?
qa.answer: Bernard alaga emmeeme bw’eyambuka mu mitendera: okusooka omuntu yeeyagala ye yennyini ku lulwe; oluvannyuma ayagala Katonda olw’okugasibwa kwe; awo n’atuuka ku kwagala Katonda ku lwa Katonda yennyini; era ku nkomerero, ebitatera kubaawo era mu kitundu kyokka mu bulamu buno, ayagala ne ye yennyini ku lwa Katonda, ng’asikiddwa ddala okwagala kwa Katonda. Kino kiraga engeri okweyagala gye kuyinza okufuulibwamu okwagala Katonda okulongoofu.

qa.question: Kino kitabo kya mirembe egy’edda ekizibu okusoma?
qa.answer: Kimpi, era bw’olowooza obuziba bwakyo, kya bbugumu era kisomeka bulungi nnyo. Bernard awandiika ng’omuntu ayagala Katonda so si ng’omunnaddiini obunnaddiini, era ebitundu bingi eby’ekitabo kino biriko eddoboozi ly’okusinza okusinga ery’empaka. Ebifaananyi byakyo n’ebbugumu lyakyo bikikuumye nga kiramu okumala ebyasa munaana, era kikyali gumu ku miryango egisinga obwangu okuyingira mu bulamu obw’omwoyo obw’Ekikristaayo obw’omu mirembe egy’edda.

qa.question: Lwaki leero tusoma omumonaki ow’omu kyasa eky’ekkumi n’ebibiri ng’ayogera ku kwagala?
qa.answer: Kubanga ekibuuzo ky’addamu — lwaki era mu ngeri ki okwagala Katonda — kya lubeerera, era batono abakizzeemu n’obutangaavu n’omuliro bwe nnyo. Bernard asima wansi w’enneewulira n’atuuka ku nsonga lwaki okwagala Katonda kwe tumubanjibwa, era alaga ekkubo emitima eminnyogovu gye giyinza okubugumirizibwamu, ekifuula ekitabo kino okuba nga kinoonyereza mu mutima gw’omusomi ow’omulembe guno nga bwe kyali eri ow’edda.

qa.question: Omusomi yandisookedde wa?
qa.answer: Ku ntandikwa; ekitabo kino kimpi era kigenda ng’empaka emu, okuva ku lwaki Katonda asaanidde okwagalibwa, okutuuka ku kumeka, n’oluvannyuma ne kiyambuka mu mitendera gy’okwagala. Bw’okisoma mpola, nga Bernard yennyini bw’akuyita olw’okusinza kwe, si kyakuyiga kya kumaliriza wabula muliro gwa kwotako.

fields.title: Lwaki Tusaanidde Okwagala Katonda
fields.body_html:
Oyagala nkunnyonnyole lwaki era ku kigero ki gye tusaanidde okwagala Katonda.

Nandigambye nti Katonda yennyini ye nsonga ey’okumwagala, era nti ekigero ky’okwagala okumusaanira kwe kumwagala awatali kigero. Kino kitegeerekeka bulungi? Oboolyawo kiyinza okutegeerekeka eri omuntu ow’amagezi, naye njagala okuddamu abayivu n’abatali bayivu bombi; era newaakubadde nga nnyinza okuba nga njogedde ekimala eri abasooka, nsaanidde okujjukira n’abalala. Ku lwabwe nja kunnyonnyola amakulu gange, era oboolyawo nnyongereko.

Waliwo ebintu bibiri ebituleetera okwagala Katonda ku lulwe yennyini: tewali kintu kisinga kino okuba eky’amagezi; era tewali kintu kisinga kino okutugasa.

Ekibuuzo nti, Kiki ekitusiba okwagala Katonda? kiyinza okutegeeza — Katonda alina ddembe ki ku kwagala kwaffe? oba nti, Okwagala Katonda kunaatugasa kutya? Ebibuuzo bino byombi birina okuddibwamu kumu kwokka: Ensonga ey’okwagala Katonda ye Katonda. Tewali ddembe liyinza kusinga lino amaanyi: Katonda yatuwaayo ye yennyini newaakubadde nga tetwali basaanidde, era, nga bw’ali Katonda, kiki kye yandituwadde ekisinga ye yennyini omuwendo? Kale bwe tubuuza nti lwaki tusibibwa okwagala Katonda, ne tutegeeza nti alina ddembe ki, okuddamu kuli nti: Okusinga byonna kino, nti ye yasooka okutwagala. Kino kimuwa eddembe ery’okwagalibwa naffe; okusinga byonna bwe tulowooza ku oyo atwagala bw’ali, n’abaagalwa be bwe bali, n’engeri gy’abaagalamu. Kubanga ani atwagala, bw’atali oyo buli mwoyo gwe gutegeeza nti: “Ggwe Mukama wange,” era nti tolina kye weetaaga ku birungi byange? Era okwagala kwe si kwe kwagala okutanoonya byakwo? Naye okwagala kuno okutanoonya byakwo kwasimbibwa ku baani? Omutume addamu nti: “bwe twali tukyali balabe ba Katonda twatabaganyizibwa naye.” Katonda yatwagala awatali kunoonya byakwe, era nga tukyali balabe be. Naye yatwagala atya? Yokaana atuuka n’okugamba nti: “Katonda bwe yayagala ensi, bw’atyo n’awaayo Omwana we omu yekka.” Pawulo ayongerako nti: “Oyo ataasaasira Mwana we ye, naye n’amuwaayo ku lwaffe ffenna;” era Omwana ayogera ku lulwe yennyini nti, “Tewali kwagala kusinga okw’omuntu awaayo obulamu bwe olwa mikwano gye.” Ezo nno ze nsonga Katonda, Omutukuvu, Omukulu ennyo era Omuyinza w’Ebintu Byonna, z’asinziirako okubanja okwagala kw’omuntu omutono ennyo okutagerageranyizika, omunafu, era omwonoonyi. Omuntu ayinza okugamba nti: Weewaawo, kino kya mazima eri abantu, naye si bwe kiri eri bamalayika. Nkimanyi; eri bamalayika ekyo kyennyini tekyali kyetaagisa. Era ate, oyo eyayamba omuntu mu nnaku ye, ye yakuuma bamalayika obutagwa mu nnaku efaanana ng’eyo; era obanga okwagala kwa Katonda eri abantu kwabafunira ekkubo ery’okuwonamu, okwagala okwo kwennyini kwe kwakuuma bamalayika obutagwa nga ffe bwe twagwa.

fields.title: Eddembe lya Katonda ku Kwagala Kwaffe
fields.body_html:
ABO abakkirizza bye mbadde njogera tebalema kukkiriza nti tusibiddwa okwagala Katonda. Naye obanga waliwo abatakkiriza abatagenda kukola wadde ekyo, Katonda alina by’asobola okuswaza obutasiima bwabwe: ebirungi ebitabalika by’agaggawaza nabyo emmeeme n’omubiri. Omuntu si wuwe gy’aggya emmere emuwanirira, n’ekitangaala ekimwakira, n’empewo gy’assa? Bwe mbisooka okubyogerako, si lwa kuba nti mbitwala okuba ebisinga obukulu, kubanga bikwata ku mubiri gwokka, naye bye bisinga okwetaagisa. Ebirungi byaffe ebisinga obukulu tulina okubinoonyeza mu mmeeme, ekitundu ekisinga obugulumivu eky’obuntu bwaffe. Ebirungi ebyo bye bino — ekitiibwa, okutegeera, n’empisa ennungi. Bwe njogera ku kitiibwa ky’omuntu, ntegeeza eddembe ery’okwesalirawo eriri mu ye, kubanga lye limusitula okusinga ebitonde ebirala byonna ebiramu, ne libissa wansi w’obuyinza bwe. Okutegeera kumulaga ekitiibwa kye, era mu kiseera kye kimu kumulaga nti tekyava mu ye yennyini; era ku nkomerero, empisa ennungi zimuleetera okunoonya n’obunyiikivu, era bw’amala okumuzuula, okunywerera n’amaanyi, oyo gw’ali mulimu gwe. Buli kimu ku birungi bino ebisatu kirina enjuuyi bbiri. Ekitiibwa kirabibwa ng’enkizo esaanidde obuntu, era ng’ekireeta okutya omuntu kw’abadde bulijjo ng’aleetera buli kiramu ekirala. Okutegeera kulaba ekitiibwa ky’omuntu, naye mu kiseera kye kimu kukkiriza nti newaakubadde nga kiri mu ye, tekyava mu ye; era ku nkomerero, empisa ennungi mu mirimu gyazo ebiri zikubiriza okunoonya n’ennyonta oyo gwe tubanjibwa okubaawo kwaffe, era bwe tumala okumuzuula, okumunywerera n’ennyonta y’emu. Ate era, ekitiibwa awatali kutegeera tekiriiko kye kigasa; n’okutegeera awatali mpisa nnungi kuyinza kukola kabi kokka; nga bwe kiraga ensonga eno wammanga. Tewali kutegeera kuyinza kwenyumiriza mu kubaawo kwakwo nga tekumanyi nti kuliwo; naye obanga, nga kumanyi nti kuliwo, tekufaayo kumanya nti kuliwo si lwa kwakwo, wabula olw’omulala, ne kwegulumiza mu kwo kwokka so si mu Katonda, kusaanidde okufumiitiriza ku bigambo by’Omutume nti: “mulina kye mutaaweebwa? Kale obanga ddala mwaweebwa, kiki ate ekibenyumirizisa ng’abataakifuna?” Tagamba bugambi nti, “kiki ate ekibenyumirizisa?” wabula ayongerako nti, “ng’abataakifuna,” ng’alaga nti si kibi okwenyumiriza olw’okuba n’ekintu, wabula okwenyumiriza ng’ataakiweebwa. Kya nsonga okuyita okwenyumiriza okwo okwenyumiriza okutaliimu, kubanga tekwesigamye ku lwazi lunywevu olw’amazima. Omutume akwawula ku kwenyumiriza okutuufu bw’agamba nti: “eyeenyumiriza yeenyumirizenga mu Mukama waffe,” kwe kugamba mu mazima, kubanga Katonda ge mazima.

Kale tulaba nti waliwo ebintu bibiri bye tulina okumanya: Okusooka, bye tuli; ate, nti ebyo bye tuli tebyava mu ffe ffennyini. Bwe tulemwa kimu ku bino byombi, oba tetujja kwenyumiriza n’akatono, oba ekitiibwa kye twetwalira kijja kuba kya “butaliimu.” Era ku nkomerero: “Bw’oba nga tomanyi” — kwe kugamba, nga teweemanyi wekka — “goberera ekkubo endiga lye zikutte.” Era ddala kino kye kibaawo; kubanga omuntu ali mu kitiibwa bw’atamanya kitiibwa kye, olw’obutamanya obwo afaananyizibwa mu bwenkanya n’ensolo z’agabana nazo okuvunda n’obulamu obuggwaawo obw’ensi eno. Ekitonde amagezi kye gaawula ku nsolo, bwe kitamanya kyokka, kyetabula nazo; kubanga, olw’obutamanya kitiibwa kyakyo ekiri munda mwokka, kyewaayo eri okwagala okumanya okutaliimu, ne kyemalira ku bulungi obw’ebweru obulabibwa n’amaaso. Kikka ne kifaanana ebitonde ebya wansi, olw’obutamanya nti kyaweebwa ekintu ekisinga ebyo. Era buno bwe butamanya bwe tulina okwekuuma n’obwegendereza bwonna. Tetulina n’akatono kwetwala nga tuli wansi w’ebyo Katonda bye yatukola. Naye n’obwegendereza obusingawo tulina okwewala obutamanya obulala, obutuleetera okwetwalira ebisinga bye tulina; kino tukikola bwe twewaako mu bukyamu ebirabo bye tuyinza okumanya nti tulina. Ng’oggyeeko engeri zino ebbiri ez’obutamanya, wasigalawo ekintu eky’okukyayibwa n’okuddukibwa okusingawo: amalala agandituleetedde okwenyumiriza nga tumanyi bulungi olw’obulungi bwe tuyinza okumanya nti tulina, awatali kutya kunyaga mulala kitiibwa ky’asaanira olw’ebintu bye tumanyi obulungi nti tebyava mu ffe. Mu ngeri esooka, tetwenyumiriza n’akatono. Mu ey’okubiri, twenyumiriza, naye si mu Katonda. Mu ey’okusatu, tetukyayonoona mu butamanya wabula mu bugenderevu, nga tweddiza ekyo ekya Katonda yekka. Obukakanyavu buno, bwe bugeraageranyizibwa n’ensobi ey’okubiri, businga mu kino: nti bunyooma Katonda, so ng’ate eyo endala yali tamumanyi. Bwe bugeraageranyizibwa n’esooka, butufaananya ne badayimooni; so ng’eyo endala yatufaananya n’ensolo. Amalala gokka, ekibi ekisinga ebibi byonna, ge gayinza okutufuula abaliko omusango olw’okukozesa ebirabo bye twaweebwa ng’ebyaffe mu buzaaliranwa, n’olw’okunyaga Omugabi waffe, ku lwaffe ffekka, ekitiibwa ekikye mu bwenkanya. Noolwekyo ku kitiibwa ne ku kutegeera tulina okwongerako empisa ennungi, ekibala kyabyo ekisaanidde. Mu mpisa ennungi mwe tunoonyeza era mwe tutuukira ku Mutonzi omugabi w’ebintu byonna, oyo gwe tusaanidde mu bintu byonna okuwa ekitiibwa ekimusaanira; bwe kitaba bwe kityo tujja kubonaabona olw’okumanya ekituufu ne tulagajjalira okukikola. Oyo akola bw’atyo

takozesezza magezi ge ku lw’obulungi, wabula “ku kitanda kye afumiitiriza ebibi;” agezezaako, ng’omuddu omubi, okukyusa n’okwetwalira ekitiibwa Mukama we omulungi kye yandifunye, so nga amanyi bulungi olw’ekirabo ky’okutegeera nti ye yennyini teyalina ddembe ku kyo. Kyeyoleka bulungi nti ekitiibwa awatali kutegeera tekiriiko kye kigasa, era nti okutegeera awatali mpisa nnungi kutwala mu kuzikirira. Naye eri omuntu alina empisa ennungi, okutegeera wadde ekitiibwa tebiyinza kumukola kabi; ayimusa eddoboozi lye n’atendereza Katonda n’obunyiikivu ng’agamba nti: “Si ffe, Ayi Mukama, si ffe. Wabula erinnya lyo lye ligwana okuweebwanga ekitiibwa;” kwe kugamba nti: “Mukama, tetwetwalira kutegeera wadde ekitiibwa; byonna tubikwasa ggwe, kubanga byonna bye tulina twabifuna okuva gy’oli.”

Naye tuwabyemu katono, olw’okwagala kwaffe okulaga nti abo abatamanyi Kristo, nabo bennyini, bayigirizibwa bulungi etteeka ery’obutonde, n’ebirabo bye balina eby’omubiri n’emmeeme, okwagala Katonda ku lwa Katonda yennyini. Okuddamu mu bigambo bitono ebyogeddwa waggulu: Atakkiriza ali ludda wa atamanyi nti okuva eri oyo yekka ayakiza abatuukirivu n’abatali batuukirivu omusana gwe, era atonnyeza abatukuvu n’aboonoonyi enkuba, okuva eri oyo yekka mw’afunidde byonna ebyetaagisa obulamu; ekitangaala, empewo, n’emmere? Muntu ki, ne bw’aba atatya Katonda atya, akwasa ekitiibwa eky’enjawulo eky’ezzadde ly’abantu omulala yenna okuggyako oyo agamba mu Olubereberye nti, “Tukole omuntu mu kifaananyi kyaffe mu ngeri yaffe”? Ani alaba nnannyini kutegeera mu mulala yenna okuggyako mu oyo ayigiriza abantu bonna? Mu mukono ki omulala omuntu yenna mw’alowooza okufunira empisa ennungi, okuggyako mu Katonda ow’empisa ennungi? Kale Katonda alina eddembe ddala ery’okwagalibwa ku lulwe yennyini, ne mu kumanya kw’atakkiriza atamanyi Kristo; era oyo atayagala Mukama Katonda we n’omutima gwe gwonna, n’emmeeme ye yonna, n’amaanyi ge gonna, talina kya kwewolereza; kubanga obwenkanya bwe obw’obuzaaliranwa n’amagezi ge bikaaba okuva mu buziba bw’emmeeme ye nti asibiddwa okwagala ddala oyo gw’aggyako ebintu byonna. Naye kizibu nnyo, weewaawo, tekisoboka n’amaanyi ag’obutonde oba n’obuyinza bw’okwesalirawo okukwasa Katonda byonna, mu kifo ky’okwesigaliza ebimu olw’ettendo lyaffe ffekka: kyawandiikibwa nti bonna “beenoonyeza byabwe ku bwabwe;” era awalala ku muntu nti: “endowooza y’omutima gwe mbi okuva mu buto bwe.”

fields.title: Ensonga Esinga Obukulu Omukristaayo kw’Asinziira Okwagala
fields.body_html:
ABAKKIRIZA bamanyi bulungi nga beetaaga Yesu eyakomererwa; naye, bwe bakkiriza era ne beewuunya okwagala kwe, tebaswala olw’okuba nga tebalina kya kuddiza ekisa ekyo eky’okwekakkanya era ekinene bwe kityo, okuggyako ekitono, si kirala wabula bo bennyini. Okwagala kwabwe kukoleezebwa olw’okumanya nti baagalibwa nnyo bwe batyo era ku bwereere; kubanga oyo aweebwa okwagala okutono, ayagala katono. Abayudaaya wadde Abamawanga tebawulira bulumi bwa kwagala nga Ekkanisa bw’ebuwulira, egamba nti: “Mumpanirire n’ebimuli, munneetooloole n’ebibala, kubanga okwagala kunzirisizza.” Erengera Kabaka Sulemaani ng’ayambadde engule, engule nnyina gye yamutikkira. Erengera Omwana omu yekka owa Kitaawe ng’atagala wansi w’obuzito bw’omusaalaba; Katonda ow’ekitiibwa kyonna ng’ayonooneddwa olw’okukubibwa, ng’abikkiddwa amalusu; Nnannyini bulamu n’ekitiibwa ng’awanikiddwa ku misumaali, ng’afumitiddwa effumu era ng’avumibwa, ng’awaayo emmeeme ye ey’omuwendo ku lwa mikwano gye. Bw’etunuulira kino, ewulira ekitala ky’okwagala nga kifumita omutima gwayo, n’ekaaba nti:

“Mumpanirire n’ebimuli, munneetooloole n’ebibala, kubanga okwagala kunzirisizza.” Enkomamawanga Omugole, ng’ayingiziddwa mu nnimiro y’Omwagalwa we, z’asanyukira okunoga ku muti ogw’obulamu, zirina akawoomi k’Emmere eyava mu Ggulu, n’erangi y’Omusaayi gwa Kristo. Alaba okufa nga kuweereddwa ekikonde eky’okufa, n’Oyo eyakuleeta ng’ayongera ku buwanguzi bw’Oyo eyakuwangula. Alaba Omuwanguzi ng’ayimuka n’ekitiibwa okuva emagombe okutuuka ku nsi, okuva ku nsi okutuuka mu ggulu, ng’agobereddwa ekibiina ky’abanunule; “buli vviivi ery’abo abali mu ggulu n’abali ku nsi, era n’abali wansi w’ensi liryoke lifukaamirirenga erinnya lya Yesu.” Wansi w’ekikolimo eky’edda, ensi yasalirwa okumeranga amaggwa n’amatovu; naye kaakano Omugole agiyita, nga kaakano ezzibwawo olw’omukisa gwa Katonda, okumubikka n’ebimuli; era, ng’ajjukira ebigambo bino, “Omubiri gwange gwongedde okumulisa, era n’okwagala kwange nnaamutenderezanga,” azza obuggya amaanyi ge olw’ekibala eky’omuti ogw’omusaalaba, n’olw’ebimuli eby’Okuzuukira, akawoowo kaabyo ak’obwakatonda ke kasikiriza Omwagalwa okumukyalira. Awo Omwagalwa n’ayogerera waggulu nti: “Olabika bulungi muganzi wange, era onsanyusa.” Omugole alaga okwegomba kwe olw’okujja kwe, n’ebyo essuubi lye bye lyesigamyeko; si ku bulungi bwe yennyini, wabula ku kawoomi k’ebimuli ebinogeddwa mu nnimiro Mukama gy’awadde omukisa; kubanga bya muwendo eri Kristo eyasalawo okuzaalibwa n’okukulira e Nazaaleesi. Omugole omusajja ow’omu ggulu, ng’asikiriziddwa akawoowo, asanyuka okuyingira mu kisenge ky’omutima, bw’akisanga nga kiwundiddwa n’ebibala era nga kiwunya akawoowo k’ebimuli. Ajja n’ennyonta, era asanyuka okubeera mu mmeeme z’alaba nga zeewaddeyo okufumiitiriza, nga zifaayo nnyo okukuŋŋaanya ebibala by’Okubonaabona kwe, n’ebimuli eby’ekitiibwa eby’Okuzuukira kwe. Amakungula ago ag’omuwendo agaali gaengera mu mirembe gyonna egy’ebibi n’okufa, era mu nnaku zino ez’enkomerero gatuuse okukungulwa, ge makungula g’ebibala by’Okubonaabona kwe; naye mu kumasamasa kw’Okuzuukira, ebimuli we bimulisiza eby’ettoggo eriggya ekisa lye kireese ku nsi. Ku nkomerero y’ebiro, mu kuzuukira kw’abantu bonna, ebibala biriba bingi awatali kigero, “kubanga laba ttoggo aweddeko, n’enkuba eweddeyo. Ebimuli bimulisizza.” Mu bigambo bino Omugole ayagala kugamba nti: Ekyeya kidda, wamu n’Oyo eyamenya omuzira gw’ensi enkadde okuzzaawo ettoggo mu nsi yonna, ng’agamba nti: “Laba, ebintu byonna mbizzizza buggya.” Omubiri gwe, ogwasigibwa mu kufa, gumulisizza mu kuzuukira, era mu kifaananyi kye, ensenyi zaffe n’ebiwonvu byaffe, ebyali bikalu era bitaliiko kantu, oba nga bikutte omuzira, bizaaliddwa buggya mu bulamu ne mu bbugumu.

Obubisi bw’ebimuli bino, okutuukirira kw’ebibala, n’obulungi bw’ennimiro eno efulumya akawoowo akalungi ennyo bwe kati, bisanyusa ne Kitaawe w’Oyo eyafuula ebintu byonna ebiggya; era, ng’amuwa omukisa, agamba nti: “Wulira akaloosa k’omwana wange, kali ng’akaloosa k’ennimiro Mukama gy’awadde omukisa;” ennimiro ejjudde ebimuli, ddala, kubanga “Ku kujjula kwe ffenna kwe twagabana.” Naye Omugole, buli lw’ayagala, ayinza okujja nga waka n’anoga ebimuli n’ebibala, okuwunda nabyo ekisenge ky’omuntu we ow’omunda, Omugole omusajja bw’alijja asange akatanda k’omutima gwe nga kafulumya akawoowo akasinga obulungi. Era mu ngeri y’emu naffe, bwe tuba twagala Kristo ajje gye tuli abeere mu ffe, tulina okujjuza emitima gyaffe n’okulowooza ku kufa kwe n’okuzuukira kwe, n’okujjukira n’obwesigwa okusaasira n’amaanyi bye yatulaga nga biyita mu byo. Kino Dawudi kye yategeeza mu bigambo bino: “nze nziggyemu ebintu bibiri nti: Katonda, oli w’amaanyi, era ggwe, Ayi Mukama, ojjudde okwagala.” Era Kristo yakiraga mu ngeri esukkiridde; kubanga, bwe yamala okufa okutangirira ebibi byaffe, yazuukira mu bafu tulyoke tuweebwe obutuukirivu, era n’atuma Omwoyo Omutukuvu okutubudaabuda. Oluvannyuma alikomawo okumaliriza obulokozi bwaffe. Mu kufa kwe tulina obukakafu bw’okusaasira kwe n’okwagala kwe, mu kuzuukira kwe obw’amaanyi ge, era mu ebyo ebisigadde tulina obukakafu bw’ebyo byombi nga byegasse.

Omugole bw’asaba okuwanirirwa n’ebimuli eby’akawoowo n’okuzzibwamu amaanyi n’ebibala ebiwunya obulungi, kiba kubanga atya okwagala kwe kuleme kunnyogoga oba okuyongobera; naye ebimuzzaamu amaanyi ng’ebyo abinoonya okutuusa lw’aliyingizibwa mu kisenge ky’Omwagalwa we. Awo aliwulira ng’amubikka n’okunywegera kw’abadde ayaayaanira, era alyogerera waggulu nti: “Omukono gwe ogwa kkono guli wansi wa mutwe gwange, n’omukono gwe ogwa ddyo gumpambatira.” Awo aliwulira okuwambaatira kw’omukono ogwa ddyo bwe kusinga ennyo buli kawoomi, era nti ogwa kkono, gwe yamuwembejjesa nagwo mu nnaku ezaasooka ez’okujja kwe, tegugeraageranyizika nagwo. Alitegeera nti “Omubiri teguliiko kye gugasa,” era nti “Mwoyo Mutukuvu y’awa obulamu.” Aliyingira mu makulu g’ebigambo bye bino: “Omwoyo gwange guwoomera okusinga omubisi gw’enjuki, n’obusika bwange businga omubisi gw’enjuki n’ebisenge byagwo.” Obanga era kyawandiikibwa nti, “Okujjukirwa kwange kwa mirembe na mirembe,” kiri kulaga nti abalonde abatannakkusibwa kubeerawo kw’Omugole omusajja balina waakiri ekifaananyi kye eky’okubabudaabuda kaakano ng’ebiro bikyagenda. Obanga kyawandiikibwa nti, “Banaayogeranga ku bulungi bwo obw’ekitalo nga bajaguza,” kitegeeza lwatu abo omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli be yali amaze okwogerako nti: “Buli mulembe gunaatenderanga gunnaagwo ebikolwa byo.” Ku nsi waliwo okujjukira kwokka okw’Omugole omusajja; mu ggulu, Okubeerawo kwe okw’olubeerera. Kino kye kitiibwa ky’abo abamaze okutuuka ku mwalo; era ekyo kye kibudaabuda abo abakyalwanagana n’amayengo.

fields.title: Abaani Abafuna Okubudaabudibwa mu Katonda
fields.body_html:
KIRUNGI okulowooza ku abo abawulira nga babudaabudibwa olw’okulowooza ku Katonda. Si abo abaggwaamu ekitiibwa, abanyiiza Katonda buli kiseera, era be bagamba nti: “zibasanze mmwe abagagga, kubanga mufunye essanyu lyammwe erijjuvu;” wabula abo abayinza okugamba mu mazima nti: “emmeeme yange neegaana okusanyusibwa.” Kya nsonga abo abatannafuna ssanyu ery’okubeerawo kw’Omwagalwa okutunuulira ebiseera eby’omu maaso; era abo abanyooma okukkiriza ekintu kyonna okuva mu mugga gw’amasanyu agayita, banyumirwa nnyo, mu ssuubi, essanyu eriribeerawo emirembe gyonna. Abo be bantu abanoonya amaaso ga Mukama, Katonda wa Yakobo, so si bo bennyini. Okulowooza ku Katonda kuwoomera abo abamusindira emmeeme, era buli kassa kaabwe kajjukira okubeerawo kwe; naye, mu kifo ky’okukkakkanya enjala yaabwe gy’ali, kugyongera. Kino yakyogera edda mu bigambo bino: “Abo abandya balirumwa enjala nate,” era, ng’oyo alumwa enjala bw’ayogera: “ndimatira, bwe ndiraba obwenyi bwo nga nzuukuse.” Naye ne kaakano balina omukisa abalumwa enjala n’ennyonta olw’obutuukirivu, kubanga abo bokka be balikkusibwa. Zikusanze, ggwe ezzadde ekyamu era ebbi; zibasanze mmwe abantu abasirusiru era abatategeera, abatayagala kulowooza ku ye, naye abatya okulabika kwe. Mulina ensonga ennungi okutya, kubanga kaakano temugenda kuwona mutego gw’omuyizzi; kubanga “abaagala okugaggawala bagwa mu kukemebwa ne mu katego” ka Setaani. Ku lunaku olwo temujja kulema kugwa wansi w’omusango ogw’entiisa, weewaawo ogutaliimu ssuubi: “Muveewo, mmwe abakolimire, mulage mu muliro ogutazikira.” Naye nga kiwooma, nga kwa kisa ekisuubizo ekyo kye tuwulira Ekkanisa ng’ekyogera buli lunaku okujjukira Okubonaabona kwe: “Buli alya omubiri gwange n’anywa n’omusaayi gwange, ng’afunye obulamu obutaggwaawo;” ekitegeeza nti, oyo assaamu ekitiibwa okufa kwange, n’afiiza omubiri gwe ku nsi ng’agoberera ekyokulabirako kyange, aliba n’obulamu obutaggwaawo; oba nti, bw’obonaabona nange, olifugira wamu nange. Naye, ne leero, bangi bwe bawulira ebigambo ebyo bakyuka ne bagenda nga banakuwavu, nga bagamba mu bikolwa byabwe, oba si mu kamwa: “Ekigambo ekyo kizibu okutegeera. Ani asobola okutunnyonnyola ky’agamba?” Abo, mu kifo ky’okukuuma emitima gyabwe nga mirongoofu n’okuba abeesigwa eri Katonda, abaagala okussa emitima gyabwe ku bugagga obutali bwa nkalakkalira, tebayinza kugumiikiriza kwogera ku Musaalaba; okulowooza bulowooza ku Kubonaabona kwe kubalabikira ng’ekitagumiikirizika. Abo baligumiikiriza batya omusango gw’Omulamuzi: “Muveewo, mmwe abakolimire, mulage mu muliro ogutazikira ogwateekerwateekerwa Setaani ne bamalayika be”? Ebigambo bino birimenya, ng’olwazi olunene, abo be biribagwako. Naye Abatukuvu baliweebwa omukisa. Nga Omutume, tebalina kirala kye beegomba wabula, “oba nga tuli ewaffe oba nga tetuli waffe, tumusanyuse.” Nabo baliwulira omusango gwabwe: “Mujje mmwe Kitange be yawa omukisa, musikire obwakabaka obwabateekerwateekerwa.” Ku lunaku olwo abo abatakuumye mitima gyabwe bulungi baliwulira, nga kikeerezi, ekikoligo n’omugugu gwa Kristo bwe biwooma era bwe biweweevu, bye baagaana okwetikka olw’amalala, olw’obukakanyavu bw’omutima gwabwe, ng’abalowooza nti mugugu gwa nsonyi era ogubetenta. Tekisoboka, mmwe abaddu abaavu, okufubira obugagga bw’ensi eno, ate era mu kiseera kye kimu okwenyumiriza mu Musaalaba gwa Mulokozi waffe Yesu Kristo; okwegomba n’okufubira ebintu eby’oku nsi ate era okulega ku kawoomi ka Mukama waffe. Ddala olunaku lumu mulimulaba nga wa ntiisa nnyo, oyo okulowooza ku ye kwe kutabaddenga ssanyu lyammwe.

Naye emmeeme ekkiriza esinda olwa Katonda n’omutima gwayo gwonna, era ebeera mu kulowooza ku ye; yeenyumiriza mu nsonyi z’Omusaalaba, okutuusa lw’erilaba Omulokozi waayo amaaso ku maaso. Eri ng’ejjiba lya Kristo, era enyumirwa otulo n’okuwummula wakati mu birungi by’agiwadde. Ebiwaawaatiro byayo byeru nga ffeeza olw’obulongoofu n’obutaliiko kya kunenyezebwa, ebikwatagana, Ayi Mukama Yesu, n’okwegomba kw’akawoomi ko akatayogerekeka; era ate essuubi lyayo liri nti, mu kitiibwa ekyakaayakana okuva ku maaso go, “ebyoya byayo birimasamasa nga zaabu,” era ejja kujjula essanyu n’okubunyisibwamu ekitangaala okuva mu maaso go mu kusikirizibwa kw’Abatukuvu. Kale erina ensonga ennungi okugamba kaakano n’essanyu nti: “Omukono gwe ogwa kkono guli wansi wa mutwe gwange, n’omukono gwe ogwa ddyo gumpambatira.” Omukono gwe ogwa kkono kwe kujjukira okwagala okwo obunene bwakwo tewali ayinza kubwenkanya, kwe yawaayo obulamu bwe ku lw’abo be yali ayagala. Omukono gwe ogwa ddyo kwe kulaba okw’essanyu kw’asuubizza abantu be, n’okumatira kw’alibajjuza n’alibatikkira engule bwe balinyumirwa okubeerawo kwe okw’obwakatonda. Kyawandiikibwa mu Zabbuli nti: “mu mukono gwo ogwa ddyo nga mwe muli ebisanyusa emirembe gyonna.” Kale omukono gwe ogwa ddyo gufuulibwa mu bwenkanya akabonero k’essanyu eryo ery’obwakatonda era erifuula omuntu okufaanana Katonda, essanyu eritalowoozekeka eriri mu kulaba Katonda. Mu ngeri y’emu, omukono ogwa kkono guli ng’entebe y’okwagala okwo okw’ekitalo kwe mbadde njogerako, kwe tutayinza kulowoozaako kusukkiridde, kubanga ku mukono guno Omugole kw’assa omutwe gwe n’awummula okutuusa obutali butuukirivu buno lwe bulivaawo. Omutwe gwe tuyinza okugutegeera okuba ekigendererwa ky’emmeeme ye, ky’assa ku mukono gw’Omwagalwa we, aleme okugwa olw’obunafu n’asikirizibwa ebintu eby’oku nsi byokka; kubanga omugugu ogw’oku nsi era oguvunda ogw’omubiri guzitoowerera nnyo emmeeme, ne gugikululira wansi okuva ku birowoozo by’eteyinza kulema kulinnyamu bw’ewummulira ku kufumiitiriza ku kusaasira kwe yali tesaanira n’akatono, ku kwagala okugabi ennyo era okwalagibwa mu bujjuvu, ku buwombeefu n’akawoomi ebigumiikiriza bwe bityo era ebirungi ennyo bwe bityo, ku kitiibwa ekitalowoozebwangako. Kisoboka ebyo obutagulumiza magezi agabifumiitirizaako, ne bigaggya ku buli kwagala okutasaana, ne bigeyongeramu munda nnyo nnyo, ne bigaleetera okunyooma byonna ebiteyinza kunyumirwa awatali kulekayo essanyu lino erisinga? Akawoomi kaabyo, ng’akawoowo ak’omuwendo, kamusikiriza; ayanguya entambula ye n’essanyu, era omutima gwe gwonna gwaka omuliro gw’okwagala. Okumanya nti ayagalibwa n’ekisa bwe kityo kumuleetera okwerowooza ng’omunnyogovu, newaakubadde ng’okwagala bwe bulamu bwe bwennyini. Kiki kye kiddiza okwagala okukka okuva waggulu bwe kutyo, era okw’ekitalo bwe kutyo, singa akaweke k’enfuufu akaavu kookebwa ddala okwebaza n’okwagala? Ekitiibwa ky’eggulu si kye kyasooka okwagala? Tekyeyoleka ng’ekyewaddeyo ddala ku mulimu gw’okumulokola? Kubanga “Katonda bwe yayagala ensi, bw’atyo n’awaayo Omwana we omu yekka.” Kino kyawandiikibwa lwatu ku Katonda Kitaffe. Era nate: “yafuka obulamu bwe okutuusa okufa;” kino kyogerwa ku Mwana. Era ku Mwoyo Omutukuvu tusoma nti: “Omubeezi, Mwoyo Mutukuvu, Kitange gw’alituma mu linnya lyange, bw’alijja alibayigiriza ebintu byonna era alibajjukiza byonna bye nabagamba.” Mu kino tulaba nti Katonda atwagala, era atwagala n’obulamu bwe bwonna; kubanga Obusatu Obutukuvu bwonna awamu butwagala, bwe tuba nga tuyinza okwogera bwe tutyo ku Oyo atakoma era atategeerekeka, ali omu era atayawulwamu.

fields.title: Omulimu gw’Okwagala Katonda
fields.body_html:
BYONNA ebyogeddwa biraga lwatu nnyo omulimu gw’okwagala Katonda, n’eddembe ly’alina ku kwagala kwaffe. Kale atakkiriza ali atya? Nga bw’atamanyi Katonda Omwana, bw’atyo era tamanyi Kitaffe n’Omwoyo Omutukuvu; era nga bw’atawa Mwana kitiibwa, bw’atyo tagulumiza Kitaffe eyamutuma, wadde Omwoyo Omutukuvu, ekirabo kya bombi. Amanyi Katonda kitono okusinga ffe, kale si kya kwewuunya nti amwagala kitono. Wabula waliwo ekintu kimu ky’amanyi; nti oyo eyamutonda amubanja ye yennyini yonna. Naye nze ndiba ntya? kubanga sirina butamanya bwe nnyinza kwewolereza nabwo. Mmanyi nti Katonda yantonda nga sirina kye mmusaanidde, nti ammalira byonna bye neetaaga, ambudaabuda n’okusaasira, era anfuga n’okufaayo okw’obwegendereza; era si ekyo kyokka, naye mmanyi n’okwongerako nti ye Mununuzi wange, Nnannyini bulokozi bwange obutaggwaawo, obugagga bwange n’ekitiibwa kyange. Nga bwe kyawandiikibwa nti: “era y’alina okununula okutuukiridde;” “yayingira mu Watukuvu w’Awatukuvu omulundi gumu gwokka n’omusaayi gwe; bw’atyo ye yennyini n’atufunira obulokozi obutaggwaawo.” Atukuuma nga tuli bulungi, nga bwe kyawandiikibwa nti: “Ennaku z’abataliiko kya kunenyezebwa, zimanyibwa Mukama, era omugabo gwabwe gunaabanga gwa lubeerera.” Atugaggawaza, nga bwe yagamba nti: “Ekigera ekirungi ekikattiddwa, ekisuukundiddwa, eky’omuyiika kiribakwasibwa;” era awalala nti: “Eriiso bye litalabangako … Katonda bye yategekera abo abamwagala.” Atujjuza ekitiibwa, nga Omutume bw’agamba nti: “Omulokozi, Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo, gye tumulindirira okuva. Kale bw’alijja emibiri gyaffe gino eminafu egifa aligifuula ng’ogugwe ogw’ekitiibwa.” Era nate: “Okubonaabona kwe tubonaabona kaakano kutono nnyo bwe kugeraageranyizibwa n’ekitiibwa ekiritubikulirwa;” era ekiseera kino eky’okubonaabona okw’ensi eno (ekimpi ennyo bwe kityo, ekiddukira ddala bwe kityo) kituleetera (bwe tuba nga, nga tunyooma ebirabika, tussa amaaso gaffe ku bintu ebitalabika) “ekitiibwa eky’amaanyi eky’emirembe n’emirembe.”

Olw’ebyo byonna, “Mukama ndimusasula ntya”? Amagezi n’etteeka ly’Obutonde bimpaliriza nnyo okwewaayo ddala gy’ali awatali kwesigaliza, oyo gwe nfunidde byonna bye nnina, n’okuwaayo obulamu bwange bwonna eri okumwagala. Era okukkiriza kundaga nti mpalirizibwa okumwagala okusinga bwe neeyagala nze, gye nkoma okutegeera nti olw’obugabi bwe mmubanjibwa si ebyo byonna bye ndi byokka, naye n’okusingawo ekirabo kye yennyini.

Naye tulowooze nti, olunaku lw’okukkiriza okw’Ekikristaayo nga terunnatuuka, Katonda nga tannayambala mubiri gwaffe n’afiira ku musaalaba, n’akka emagombe n’alinnya eri Kitaawe, kwe kugamba, okujjula kw’okwagala kwe gye tuli nga tekunnaba kwakaayakana, edda ennyo nga tekunnabaawo, omuntu yali alagiddwa okwagala Mukama Katonda we n’omutima gwe gwonna, n’emmeeme ye yonna, n’amaanyi ge gonna, kwe kugamba, n’obulamu bwe bwonna, n’okwagala kwonna kw’ayinza okubeera nakwo, ng’ekitonde ekyaweebwa amagezi n’okwesalirawo. Kyandibadde kya butali bwenkanya Katonda okwetwalira omulimu gwe yennyini n’ebirabo bye? Lwaki ekyakolebwa tekyandyagadde Katonda eyakikola, ng’era kyaweebwa n’obusobozi obw’okwagala; era lwaki tekyandimwagadde n’amaanyi gaakyo gonna, obanga buli kye kirina kyakifuna okuva eri Katonda yekka? Lowooza n’ekyo, nti omuntu teyayitibwa kuva mu butaliiko kintu okubaawo kwokka, nga talina ddembe lyonna lye yasooka okuba nalyo, naye n’okuyitibwa okwo kwali kwa kumusitula okumutuusa mu kitiibwa ekinene. Bwe tutyo tujja kulaba obulungi okusingawo nti tusibiddwa okumwagala ddala, era nti alina eddembe ku kwagala kwaffe. Ate era, omuntu bwe yakka n’atuuka ku ddaala ly’ensolo ezizikirira, Katonda teyayingira mu nsonga okumuzzaawo n’okumulokola? Kino si kye kyewuunyo ky’obulungi bwe n’okusaasira kwe? Kubanga olw’ekibi twali tugudde okuva mu kitiibwa ky’okutondebwa kwaffe, ne tufuuka ng’ensolo, ng’ente erya omuddo, etaliiko kitangaala kya magezi. Obanga mbanjibwa nze yennyini yonna Omutonzi wange, kiki kye sibanjibwa Omununuzi wange, era Omununuzi ali bw’atyo! Okutonda gwali mulimu mutono nnyo okusinga okununula; kubanga Katonda yalina kwogera kigambo kyokka ne byonna ne bitondebwa; naye okuddaabiriza okugwa kw’ekyo ekigambo ekimu kye kyatonda, bya kyewuunyo ki by’ataalina kukola, bukambwe ki, weewaawo, kuswazibwa ki kw’ataalina kugumiikiriza!

Kale, “Mukama ndimusasula ntya olw’ebirungi bye ebingi bwe bityo by’ankoledde?” Bwe yantonda, yampa nze yennyini; naye yanzizaawo gye ndi bwe yeewaayo ye yennyini gye ndi: bwe nnasooka okuweebwa ate ne nzzibwawo, mmubanjibwa nze yennyini emirundi ebiri. Naye, kiki kye mbanjibwa Katonda olw’ekirabo kye yennyini? Singa mmuwa obulamu bwange bwonna emirundi lukumi, ekyo kyandibadde ki bwe kigeraageranyizibwa ne Katonda?

fields.title: Mu Bufunze
fields.body_html: NKKIRIZA nti Katonda asaanidde okwagalibwa ennyo, oba okusinga nti asaanidde okwagalibwa awatali kigero. Ye yasooka okwagala; ye omukulu ennyo bw’atyo, ffe abatono ennyo bwe tutyo; atwagala okusukkiridde, nga bwe tuli, era nga ffe tetulina ddembe lyonna lye tumubanja. Eyo ye nsonga lwaki ekigero ekituufu eky’okwagala kwaffe eri Katonda kwe kusukka buli kigero; kubanga Katonda, gwe twagala, bw’aba nga takoma, tuyinza tutya okupima oba okugera kye tumubanjibwa mu kwagala? Ate era, okwagala kwaffe si kirabo kye tuwaayo ku bwagazi bwaffe; kwe kusasula ebbanja. Era n’okwongerako, olw’okuba nga ye NDI, ow’emirembe n’emirembe era atapimika, Okwagala okw’Obwakatonda, Katonda, obukulu bwe obutaliiko kkomo n’amagezi ge agataliiko nsalo, ye Mirembe “egisukkiridde okutegeera;” olw’okuba, nziramu, nga Katonda ali bw’atyo y’atwagala, kisoboka ffe okugamba nti tujja kumwagala kino kyokka so si okusingawo? “Nkwagala Ayi Mukama kubanga ggwe maanyi gange. Mukama lwe lwazi lwange, ky’ekigo kyange ekigumu era ye mununuzi wange,” ggwe ali gye ndi byonna emmeeme yange by’eyetaaga, era byonna omutima gwange bye gwegomba. Katonda wange era Omuyambi wange, nja kukwagala n’amaanyi gange gonna; si ng’ebyo by’osaanira bwe biri, wabula ng’obusobozi bwange obutono bwe buli. Nja kukwagala okusingawo bw’olimpa amaanyi amangi ag’okwagala; naye tekiribaawo, tekiribaawo n’akatono, nga bw’osaanidde okwagalibwa. Amaaso go galaba obusirusiru bwange, obutasobola bwange; naye mmanyi nti ggwe owandiika mu kitabo kyo abo abakola kye basobola, ne bwe baba nga tebasobola kukola kye basaanidde. Kale saayogedde ekimala okulaga nti Katonda asaanidde okwagalibwa, n’ebirabo ki bye yafunyisa okwagala kwaffe? Ebirabo bye mbyogerako bwogezi, kubanga obulungi bwabyo ani ayinza okubwogera, ani ayinza okubutegeera, ani ayinza okubuwulira?

fields.title: Empeera y’Okwagala Katonda
fields.body_html:
KA tulabe omugaso ki ogutuvaamu olw’okwagala Katonda. Ne bwe tuba nga tugulaba mu ngeri etatuukiridde n’akamu, ekyo kisinga okubeera abazibe b’amaaso ku gwo. Twogedde (newaakubadde mu ngeri etasaanira Katonda, naye ng’amaanyi gaffe bwe gakoma) ku ddembe Katonda ly’alina ku kwagala kwaffe; kaakano tujja kwogera ku mpeera gy’ateeka ku kumwagala kwaffe; kubanga newaakubadde nga tulina okwagala Katonda awatali kulowooza ku mpeera yonna, wabula tetulirema kusasulwa olw’okuba twamwagala. Okwagala okwa nnamaddala tekuyinza kulekebwa nga tekuliiko mpeera, newaakubadde nga si kwa kupangisibwa, era “tekunoonya byakwo.” Okwagala kwe kufuluma kw’emmeeme, so si ndagaano; tekuva mu kukkaanya, era tekufunibwa lwa kuteesa; kujja kwokka ku bwakwo, era kutufaananya nakwo; era okwagala okwa nnamaddala kwe kukkusa kwakwo kwokka. Empeera yaakwo eri mu kyo kye kwagala; kubanga buli kye tulabika nga twagala, obanga kye tugenderera ddala kintu kirala,

mazima ekintu ekyo kye twagala, so si ekyo omutima gwaffe kye gukozesa okukituukako. Pawulo teyabuulira njiri olw’emmere ye eya buli lunaku, wabula emmere eyamukuumanga nga mulamu yamusobozesa okubuulira enjiri. Kye yali ayagala yali njiri, so si mmere. Okwagala okwa nnamaddala tekunoonya mpeera, naye kugisaanira; kya mazima ddala nti tewali n’omu alowooza kusasula olw’okwagala, newaakubadde nga tekusaanira mpeera yaakwo kyokka, naye kulifuna ddala. Mu bintu eby’omutendera ogwa wansi, baani abakubirizibwa n’okusuubizibwa empeera? Abagayaavu n’abatalina kwagala. Waliwo omuntu yenna eyali alowoozezza okusikiriza n’empeera abo abaagala ennyo okukkirizibwa okuweereza? Toyinza kuwa muntu alumwa enjala ssente okumusendasenda okulya, wadde maama alina ekisa okumusendasenda okuyonsa omwana we, oba omulimi w’emizabbibu okukuuma emizabbibu gye, oba nnannyinimu okuddamu okuzimba ennyumba ye eyagwa. N’okusingawo, oyo ayagala Katonda teyeetaaga kukubirizibwa na kisuubizo kya mpeera endala etali Katonda yennyini; bwe kitaba bwe kityo yandibadde ayagala mpeera, so si Katonda.

Kya butonde eri ekitonde ekirina amagezi okwegomba ekyo ekirabika gy’ali, ng’engeri ye ey’okulowooza bw’eri, nti kisinga ky’alina; era obutamatira n’akatono singa ekintu ekirungi kibulako engeri gy’asinga okwagala. Bw’aba ayagala obulungi bw’endabika, ajja kwegomba ekyo kyokka ky’alaba nga kye kisinga obulungi. Bw’aba yeenyumiriza mu kuba n’ejjinja ery’omuwendo ennyo, ajja kwegomba okuba n’erisinga okumasamasa; era obugagga bwonna bw’ayinza okuba nabwo, obutonde bwe bwe bwetaaga obusingawo. Kino si kye tulaba buli lunaku, nnannyini ttaka eddene n’obugagga obungi ng’agula ettaka eddala, era nga tamatira okuggyako ng’agaziya ebyalo bye? Abo ababeera mu mbiri ennene, tebazimba nzibwe empya buli kiseera, nga bakyusa buli kaseera, nga bafuula ebyali ebya nsonda okuba ebyekulungirivu, n’ebyekulungirivu okuba eby’ensonda? Abantu abali mu bifo ebya waggulu tebeegomba buli kiseera ebisingawo obugulumivu, nga bafuba buli kiseera okulinnya, olw’okwegomba ekyeyongera okubeera ekizibu okukkusa? Okutamatira okwo tekulina kkomo, kubanga, mu bintu ebyo byonna, tekisoboka kutuuka ku kifo ekirungi era ekya waggulu ddala. Naye si kya kwewuunya nti omuntu, bw’aba akyalaba waggulu we ekintu ekisingako obukulu n’okutuukirira, tamatira na ky’alina ekitono era ekibi okusingawo. Ekirabika ng’obusirusiru obutayogerekeka, kwe kwegombanga buli kiseera ebintu ebitasobola wadde okwebasa okwegomba kwaffe, n’akatono okukukkusa. Kiki ekiddirira? kino — nti omutima, ng’ogezesebwa obulungi obulimba bungi, gwekooya bwereere, gwegomba buli kiseera, era gutwala ng’ekitaliiko kye kigasa kye gwanyumirwa, bwe kigeraageranyizibwa n’ekyo kye gwandyagadde okuba nakyo; era gubonyaabonyezebwa, olw’okwegomba kye gutalina, ne guggwaamu essanyu lyonna mu kye gulina. Omuntu tayinza kuba na byonna; ku kitono ekisoboka okufunibwa, omuwendo gw’okutegana gulina okusasulwa; era kirina okunyumirwa nga tukankana; weewaawo, nga tukakasa mu nnaku nti olunaku lumu kirina okubula, newaakubadde ng’olunaku olwo terumanyiddwa.

Nnyonnyodde empisa y’okwagala okukyamu okunoonya mu buzibe bw’amaaso obulungi obusinga byonna. Kwanguwa bwereere, nga kuzannyirwamu obutaliimu bwakwo, nga kulimbiddwa obutali butuukirivu. Lwaki omuntu amaliriza olunaku mu kulwanagana okutaliiko kye kuvaamu, eno n’eri, okufa ne kumusanga nga tamatidde? Mu mitego egiri bwe gityo abatatya Katonda mwe beezingira, abanoonya wonna wonna, ng’abasirusiru, okufuna emmeeme zaabwe bye zeegomba. Bamalira obulamu bwabwe mu kufuba okutaliiko mugaso, ne batatuuka ku ssanyu lyonna eritukiridde; kubanga baagala ebitonde, so si Omutonzi, era babigezaako, kimu ate ekirala, nga tebannaba wadde kulowooza ku kugezaako Mukama eyabitonda byonna. Naye singa baali basobola okufuna emitima gyabwe bye gyegomba ne batuuka ku kuba n’ensi yonna, okuggyako Oyo eyagitonda, bandiwulidde ku nkomerero, olw’etteeka lye limu eryafuga obulamu bwabwe, nti oyo balina okuba naye, oba tebaliwummula n’akatono. Bavudde mu kwegomba okumu ne bagenda mu kulala, nga bwe beegomba buli kiseera ekintu ekisingawo; era kaakano, nga be bakama b’ebintu byonna mu ggulu ne ku nsi, mangu ddala bandisanze nga byonna tebimala, ne bazuula nga bawalirizibwa okunoonya Oyo akyabulayo, balina okunoonya Katonda yennyini. Bwe bamala okukizuula ekyo, bwe bamala okumutuukako

Ye, olwo emirembe gibaawo; tekisoboka kusukkawo. Emmeeme erina okukaaba nti: “kye nsinga okwetaaga kwe kubeera okumpi ne Katonda wange;” oba nti, “Ani gwe nnina mu ggulu, wabula ggwe? Era tewali na kimu ku nsi kye neetaaga bwe mba naawe;” era nate: “Katonda ge maanyi g’omutima gwange, era ye wange ennaku zonna.” Ne mu ngeri eyo emmeeme yandikomekkereza mu Katonda, singa yali esobola okugezaako, kimu ku kimu, ebintu byonna ebiri wansi we. Naye obulamu bumpi nnyo, n’amaanyi gandiggwaawo mu kugezaako ng’okwo; era n’abavuganya nabo bangi nnyo. Tekyandisobose kugezaako bitonde byonna n’okubisanga nga bibulako. Kyandibadde kyangu era eky’omugaso okusingawo okukola omulimu ogwo mu kulowooza okusinga mu kikolwa. Amagezi gaffe gaaweebwa okutambula n’okulaba ewala okusinga emitima gyaffe olw’ensonga eno yennyini— gasooke gakulembere, ne galemesa omutima okwesiba ku ekyo amagezi kye gatasoose kulaba nga kisaanidde okwegombebwa. “Mwekenneenyenga ebintu byonna, kale bwe bibanga ebirungi mubinywezenga.” Amagezi galina okuteekateeka ettaka eri omutima, omutima gulyoke gugoberere okusalawo kw’amagezi. Bwe kitaba bwe kityo tewali ssuubi lya kutuuka ku ekyo ekibuuzibwa nti, “Alyambuka ku lusozi lwa Mukama ye afaanana atya? Era wa ngeri ki aliyingira n’ayimirira mu nnyumba ye entukuvu?” era bwereere tuba n’amagezi agalowooza, bwe tukola ng’ensolo bwe zikola, ne tugondera byokka ebyo emibiri gyaffe bye giwulira, amagezi ne gatayingira mu nsonga. Abo abatakulemberwa magezi, ddala badduka mu mpaka, naye badduka awatali ssuubi lya kuwangula.

Bayinza batya okuwangula, nga tebasooka kufaayo ku kirabo, wabula ne bakissa ku nkomerero ddala? Bayinza batya okukola ekirala okuggyako okwezingira mu kkubo erizingazinga eritaliiko ntandikwa wadde enkomerero? Si bwe kiri eri abatuukirivu. Nga balabuddwa olw’okunenya abo abakyama bwe batyo (kubanga ekkubo erigenda mu kufa ddene era litambulirwamu bangi), balonda ekkubo erya kabaka eritakyamira ku ddyo wadde ku kkono, kubanga “Ekkubo ly’abatuukirivu ttereevu.” Bakwata ekkubo erisinga obumpi, nga bakulemberwa ekigambo ekyangu era ekyanguyiza, ekibalagira obutafaayo ku ebyo amaaso gaabwe bye galaba, wabula okutunda byonna ne babigabira abaavu; kubanga ddala balina omukisa abaavu ng’abo, era obwakabaka obw’omu ggulu bwabwe. Mukama alabirira ekkubo ly’abatuukirivu, era alisiima. Era amanyi n’ekkubo ly’omwonoonyi, mw’atayinza kulema kuzikirira. Abatuukirivu basanyufu mu bwavu bwabwe, n’abagagga tebamatira mu bungi bwabwe; kubanga omusajja ow’amagezi agamba nti: “Oyo alulunkanira ensimbi, tasobola kuba na nsimbi zimumala.” Naye “abalumwa enjala olw’obutuukirivu” “balikkusibwa.” Obutuukirivu ye mmere yaabwe gye beetaaga. Ate ebintu eby’ensi eno, emmeeme teriisibwa nabyo okusinga omubiri bwe guliisibwa empewo. Singa twalaba omuntu alumwa enjala ng’assa empewo n’akamwa akayasamye, ng’anywa empewo nnyingi okumalawo ennyonta ye, twandigambye nti, Omusirusiru oyo omwavu! Bwe kiri bwe kityo eri abo abanoonya okukkusa emmeeme n’ebirungi eby’ensi, ebigiwaga bwagi ng’empewo, ne bitagiriisa okusinga ebintu eby’omwoyo bwe biriisa emibiri gyaffe. “Weebaze Mukama, ggwe emmeeme yange;” oyo “Awa emmeeme yo ebintu ebirungi byeyagala.” Akujjuza okuva mu kujjula kwe; mu kiseera kye kimu ng’akuwa ky’oyagala, era ng’akukubiriza okwegomba ebisingawo. Akusooka, akuwanirira, akujjuza; akoleeza okwegomba mu mutima gwo, era ye yennyini ye Kigendererwa kya buli kwegomba.

Ŋŋambye nti ensonga ey’okwagala kwaffe eri Katonda ye Katonda yennyini, era kyogeddwa bulungi, kubanga ye nsibuko ekola okwagala kwaffe era ye nkomerero yaakwo. Ali bw’atyo nti tekisoboka kumumanya n’otomwagala; n’obutamussaamu ssuubi; kubanga, singa tetwasuubira kumwagala mu ngeri etuukiridde oluvannyuma, okwagala kwaffe gy’ali kaakano tekwandibadde kantu. Okwagala kwaffe kuteekebwateekebwa era kusasulwa olw’okwagala kwe. Ye asooka okutwagala olw’obulungi bwe obusukkiridde; oluvannyuma n’atubanja okumwagala naffe nga bwe kisaanidde, era n’atukkiriza okubeera n’essuubi erisinga ekitiibwa mu biseera eby’omu maaso. Mugabi eri abo abamukoowoola, naye tayinza kugaba kintu kisinga ye yennyini. Ye yennyini ye nkomerero y’ebyo bye tusaanidde, era ye mpeera yaffe. Ye mmere y’emmeeme entukuvu, omutango gw’abo abakyali mu busibe. Obanga “Mukama mulungi … eri oyo amunoonya,” ali atya eri emmeeme eyo emuzudde? Naye kino kiyinza okulabika ng’ekyewuunyisa, nti tewali ayinza kunoonya Mukama atannaba kumuzuula; kubanga by’ayagala kwe kuzuulibwa alyoke anoonyezebwe okusingawo; n’okunoonyezebwa, alyoke azuulibwe mu bujjuvu okusingawo. Naye, newaakubadde ng’ayinza okunoonyezebwa n’azuulibwa, tayinza kusookebwa. Ye bulijjo asooka; era bwe tugamba nti: “buli nkya okusaba kwange kunaatuukanga gy’oli,” kya mazima ddala nti okusaba okwo kwandibadde kunnyogovu nnyo, Ayi Katonda, singa okuluŋŋamya kwo tekwakukulembera.

Twogedde ku kutuukirizibwa kw’okwagala Katonda, kaakano ka tulabe entandikwa yaakwo bw’eri.

fields.title: Omutendera Ogusooka ogw’Okwagala
fields.body_html:
OKWAGALA kwe kumu ku nneewulira ennya ez’obutonde ensi yonna ze emanyi, ezitali za kubalibwa wano. Kale, kya butonde era kituufu okusooka okwagala Nnannyini butonde; era ekiragiro ekisooka, era ekisinga obukulu, kiri nti: “Yagalanga Mukama Katonda wo.” Naye obutonde bwa bugonvu nnyo era bunafu nnyo olw’ekiragiro ekiri bwe kityo; bulina okutandika n’okweyagala bwokka; kuno kwe kwagala okuyitibwa okw’omubiri, omuntu kw’ayagaliza ye yennyini okusooka era okusinga byonna; nga bwe kyawandiikibwa nti: “eky’omwoyo si kye kyasooka, wabula eky’omubiri obubiri kye kyasooka.” Twagala okusooka olw’obutonde, so si olw’ekiragiro— “Tewali n’omu yali akyaye omubiri gwe.” Naye okwagala kuno bwe kweyongera ennyo; bwe kuba ng’omugga oguli wakati w’emigo ne kujjula ne kubooga ensi eriraanyeewo, olwo kufuuka okwegomba okw’obwagazi bw’omubiri, era olukomera luno luteekebwawo okukuziyiza: “Yagalanga muliraanwa wo nga gwe bwe weeyagala wekka.” Kya bwenkanya oyo agabana naffe obuntu okugabana naffe n’okwagala kwaffe. Noolwekyo, omuntu yenna bw’aba tasobola kwagala baganda be okutuuka n’okulowooza ku bye beetaaga, oba ka tugambe ne ku masanyu gaabwe, yeegaane mu bintu ebyo byennyini, alyoke ayige. Omuntu yeerowoozeeko nga bw’ayagala, kasita kyokka afaayo okulowooza kye kimu ne ku muliraanwa we. Ekyo, ggwe omuntu, kye kisiba era ky’ekkomo ery’obwenkanya etteeka ly’obuntu bwo n’omuntu wo ow’omunda bye bikuteekako, oleme okutwalibwa okweyagala kwo okutuuka mu kuzikirira kwo, ng’oleka obuntu bwo mu mikono gy’abalabe b’emmeeme yo; kwe kugamba, okwegomba kwo okw’omubiri. Kisingako nnyo ggwe okugabana ne baliraanwa bo okusinga n’abalabe bo; era obanga, ng’omusajja ow’amagezi bw’abuulirira, omuntu yeegaana okwegomba kwe okw’omubiri, n’amatira n’emmere n’ebyokwambala, era n’akkiriza okukendeeza ku kwagala kwe eri ebintu by’omubiri ebirwanagana n’omwoyo, ndowooza tajja kufuna buzibu bunene mu kuwa muliraanwa we ekyo ky’agaana omulabe w’emmeeme ye. Okwagala kwe kujja kusigala mu nsalo z’obwenkanya n’obutalulunkana, okuva ku kaseera lw’awaayo eri baganda be ekyo ky’ayimirizza ku lulwe. Okweyagala kufuuka obulungi eri abalala bwe kugaziwa.

Naye singa olw’okugabira muliraanwa waffe twetuusa mu bwetaavu? Ddagala ki? Kusaba. Tulina kusaba bwokka n’obwesige eri oyo “agabira bonna atakayuka;” eri oyo Ekyawandiikibwa gwe kigamba nti: “Oyanjuluza engalo zo, ebiramu byonna n’obigabira bye byetaaga ne bikkuta;” kubanga tetuyinza kubuusabuusa nti oyo awa abantu abasinga obungi ebisinga bye beetaaga, ajja kuwa n’essanyu oyo asaba ekyo ekitayinza kubulawo; kubanga kyawandiikibwa nti: “musooke munoonye obwakabaka bwa Katonda n’obutuukirivu bwe, ebyo byonna mulibyongerwako.” Katonda mu kino yeesiba okuwa ebyetaagisa oyo yeegaana n’ayagala muliraanwa we; kubanga okwambala ekikoligo eky’obulongoofu n’okwefuga okusinga okuba omuddu w’okwegomba kwaffe okw’omubiri, kuno kwe kusooka okunoonya obwakabaka bwa Katonda n’okwegayirira obuyambi bwe ku bunyazi bw’ekibi; era bwe bwenkanya okugabana emikisa gyaffe egy’obutonde n’abo abagabana naffe obuntu. Naye okwagala kwaffe eri muliraanwa kulyoke kubeere kutuufu ddala, Katonda alina okuba n’omugabo gwe mu kwo; tekisoboka kwagala muliraanwa waffe nga bwe tusaanidde, okuggyako mu Katonda. Era oyo atayagala Katonda tayinza kwagala kintu kyonna mu ye. Noolwekyo tulina okutandika n’okwagala Katonda, bwe tutyo ne twagala muliraanwa waffe mu ye. Katonda ye nsibuko, ng’ey’ebintu ebirala byonna, bw’atyo n’ey’okwagala kwaffe gy’ali — era n’okusingawo — nga bwe yatonda obutonde, bw’atyo abuwanirira; kubanga tebwandisobodde kubaawo wadde okweyongera okubaawo awatali ye. Tulyoke tukimanye bulungi, tuleme kwewaako kintu kyonna, Katonda, mu buziba bw’amagezi ge n’okwagala kwe, yatussa wansi w’okubonaabona. Olw’okuba tuli banafu era abali mu bwetaavu, tuwalirizibwa okukyukira Katonda, era bw’atulokola tuwa erinnya lye ekitiibwa. Bino bye bigambo bye yennyini: “Bw’obanga mu buzibu, nnaakuwonyanga, naawe onongulumizanga.” Mu ngeri eno omuntu, ow’omubiri mu butonde bwe era ow’ensolo, atalina kwagala okuggyako ku lulwe, aleetebwa okuyita mu kweyagala okutuuka ku kwagala Katonda, ng’ategeera nti obusobozi bwe bwonna, waakiri obw’okukola ebirungi, abufuna okuva eri Katonda, era nti awatali ye tasobola kukola kantu.

fields.title: Omutendera ogw’Okubiri n’ogw’Okusatu ogw’Okwagala
fields.body_html: OKUSOOKA, kale, omuntu aba n’okwagala okumu eri Katonda ku lulwe ye, so si ku lwa Katonda. Kiba kintu ekirungi okuwulira ekkomo ly’obusobozi bwe, okumanya by’atayinza kukola awatali buyambi bwa Katonda, n’okusigala ng’ali bulungi n’oyo amuwanirira obulamu bwe n’amaanyi ge. Naye, ka wabeewo emitawaana egiddiriŋŋana egimutuukako ne gimuwaliriza okuddukiranga Katonda buli kiseera; bw’aba ng’akyafuna obuyambi bw’ayagala, omutima gwe gwandibadde gwa kikomo oba gwa jjinja okulema ku nkomerero okukwatibwako obulungi bw’oyo amuyamba, n’obutatandika mu kiseera ekyo okumwagala ku lulwe yennyini. Ka okugezesebwa okutera okubaawo kututuuse emirundi mingi ku bigere bya Katonda; ddala tekisoboka, wabula tulina okutandika okumumanya, era, nga tumumanyi, tulina okutuuka ku kutegeera akawoomi ke. Mangu ddala kiddirira nti tuleetebwa okumwagala nga bwe kisaanidde, okusinga nnyo olw’akawoomi n’obulungi bwe tusanga mu ye okusinga olw’okugasibwa kwaffe ffekka. Mu bigambo by’Abasamaliya eri omukazi: “Tumukkiriza si lwa bigambo byo byokka, naye naffe twewuliridde ebigambo bye. Ddala tutegedde nga ye Mulokozi w’ensi.” Mu ngeri y’emu, naffe tutuuka ku kugamba omuntu waffe ow’obutonde nti: Si ku lulwo nti twagala Mukama, wabula ffe ffennyini tulegedde ne tulaba nga bw’awooma. Ebyetaago by’obulamu buno biringa olulimi olulangirira, mu ssanyu eriyitiridde n’okwebaza, emikisa egyo bye bituyigirizza omuwendo gwagyo. Kino bwe kimala okuyigibwa, kyangu ddala okugondera ekiragiro n’okwagala muliraanwa waffe nga ffe bwe tweyagala; kubanga, bwe twagala Katonda mu mazima, twagala byonna ebibye, era okuva olwo kyangu okugondera ekigambo kino: “nga bwe mumaze okutukuza emyoyo gyammwe olw’okukkiriza amazima, ne mwagalanira ddala mu luganda lwennyini.” Tusibiddwa okutuukiriza n’essanyu ekiragiro ekiri mu bwenkanya bwe kityo, ekiragiro, ate era, ekijjudde omugaso bwe kityo kubanga tekinoonya byakyo. Kwe kwagala okusinga obulongoofu, kubanga kulagibwa mu bikolwa ebitukuvu byokka ne mu mazima; okusinga obwenkanya, kubanga kuddiza ekyo kye kufuna. Buli ayagala n’okwagala kuno, ayagala nga bw’ayagalibwa, era takyanoonya bibye, wabula ebya Yesu Kristo, nga Yesu Kristo bwe yatunoonya. Mu kino tulaba okwagala okufaanana n’okwo okwagamba nti, “Mwebaze Mukama, kubanga mulungi.” Oyo ayagala Katonda kubanga mulungi, si gy’ali, wabula mu ye yennyini, ddala ayagala Katonda ku lwa Katonda, so si nga oyo Ekyawandiikibwa gwe kyogerako nti: “Alikutendereza bw’olimukolera obulungi.”

fields.title: Omutendera ogw’Okuna ogw’Okwagala
fields.body_html:
ALINA omukisa oyo ayinza okulinnya okutuuka ku mutendera ogw’okuna ogw’okwagala, n’ayagala ye yennyini ku lwa Katonda yekka. “Obutuukirivu bwo bugulumivu ng’agasozi aganene.” Bwe kiri bwe kityo n’omutendera guno ogw’okuna ogw’okwagala, olusozi olunene, “olusozi Katonda lwe yalonda okufugirako.” “Alyambuka ku lusozi lwa Mukama ye afaanana atya?” “Singa nnina ebiwaawaatiro ng’ejjiba, nandibuuse ne ŋŋenda mpummulako.” “Eweema ye eri mu Yerusaalemi; era abeera mu Sayuuni.” “Ndabye ennaku, kubanga mbeera mu Meseki.” Ddi omubiri guno n’omusaayi guno, enfuufu eno n’ebisooto bino bye nnakolebwamu, lwe birisobola okulinnya eyo? Ddi emmeeme yange eno, ng’esikiddwa okwagala Katonda, lw’eryetunuulira ng’ekibya ekyatise, n’eyaayaanira Katonda, n’ebula mu ye, kubanga “eyeegatta ne Mukama waffe bafuuka omu mu mwoyo”? Ddi lw’erikaaba nti: “Omubiri gwange n’omutima gwange biyinza okulemwa; naye Katonda ge maanyi g’omutima gwange, era ye wange ennaku zonna”? Mutukuvu era wa mukisa oyo, omulundi gumu gwokka, okumala akaseera kamu kokka, awulidde ekintu ekifaanana bwe kiti mu bulamu bwe obufa; kubanga kino si ssanyu lya buntu, bwe bulamu obutaggwaawo okwebuza bw’otyo, ng’omuntu atalinaamu kye yeeteekamu, ng’omuntu atali. Omuntu omu ow’okufa bw’atuuka ku kino, okumala akaseera kamu era ng’atakimanyi, ekiseera kino ekibi kirabika ng’ekimwesalira okulwisaawo n’okukaayisa essanyu lye. Omubiri guno ogw’okufa gumukululira wansi, okweraliikirira n’ebizibu by’obulamu bimuzza emabega, okuvunda kw’omubiri kugaana okumuwanirira, era omulimu gwe eri muliraanwa we gumuyita n’eddoboozi ery’omwanguka akke wansi, akaabe nti: “Ayi Mukama, nga nnyigirizibwa, nziruukirira;” oba bwe kiti: “Nga ndi muntu munaku! Ani alindokola mu mubiri guno ogugenda okufa?”

Tusoma mu Byawandiikibwa Ebitukuvu nti Katonda yakola ebintu byonna ku lulwe yennyini. Noolwekyo ebitonde bye bisibiddwa okwefaananyiriza, waakiri mu kigero ekimu, endowooza y’Omutonzi waabyo. Tusaanidde okwewaayo ddala gy’ali, nga tunoonya by’asiima byokka, so si bye twagala ffe. Tujja kusanga essanyu, nnyo nnyo si mu kunoonya okugasibwa kwaffe, wabula mu kutuukirizibwa kw’ebyo by’ayagala mu ffe, nga bwe tusaba buli lunaku nti: “By’oyagala bikolebwe mu nsi, nga bwe bikolebwa mu ggulu.” Ayi okwagala okulongoofu era okutukuvu! nneewulira esinga okuwooma era ey’omukisa! Ayi okwewaayo okujjuvu okw’emmeeme etanoonya byayo; okusinga okutuukirira kubanga temuli kulowooza ku muntu yennyini; okusinga okuwooma n’ekisa kubanga byonna emmeeme by’ewulira bya Katonda!

Okutuuka ku kino, kwe kufuula emmeeme okufaanana Katonda; nga ettondo ly’amazzi ettono bwe lirabika ng’eribuze bwe litabulwa ne wayini, ne lifuna akawoomi kaayo n’erangi yaayo; era nga, bwe kissibwa mu kyoto, ekyuma kirabika ng’ekibuza obutonde bwakyo ne kifuna obw’omuliro; oba ng’empewo ejjuziddwa ebitangaala by’enjuba bw’erabika ng’efuuse ekitangaala okusinga okumulisibwa obumulisibwa. Bwe kiri bwe kityo n’obulamu obw’obutonde obw’Abatukuvu; balabika ng’abasaanuuka ne bayingira mu by’ayagala Katonda. Kubanga singa waaliwo ekintu eky’obuntu obwereere ekyasigala mu muntu, kale Katonda yandibadde atya byonna mu byonna? Si nti obuntu bulisaanawo, wabula nti bulituuka ku bulungi obulala, ku maanyi n’ekitiibwa ebisingawo. Ekyo kiribaawo ddi? Ani aliweebwa okukiraba n’okukimanya? “Ndigenda ddi ne nsisinkana Katonda?” Ayi Katonda, Mukama wange, omutima gwange gukugambye nti: “Nnaakunoonyanga, Ayi Mukama.” Abali nga nze baliweebwa okulaba yeekaalu yo entukuvu?

Mu bulamu buno, omutima guwalirizibwa okufaayo ku mubiri, amagezi okulaba nti obulamu bwagwo n’amaanyi gaagwo bikuumibwa nga tebiriiko kabi; era ndowooza nti tekisoboka, ng’amaanyi gaffe bwe gaawuddwamu bwe gatyo, okuwummulira ddala mu Katonda ne mu kumufumiitirizaako, tekisoboka okugondera mu bujjuvu ekiragiro nti, “Oyagalanga Mukama Katonda wo n’omutima gwo gwonna, n’omwoyo gwo gwonna, n’amaanyi go gonna.” Tetuyinza kusuubira kufuna mutendera ogw’okuna ogw’okwagala, oba okusinga okufugibwa gwo, okutuusa nga twambadde omubiri ogw’omwoyo era ogutafa, omulongoofu era omukkakkamu, ogugondera era ogufugibwa omwoyo mu byonna, ekitayinza kuba kikolwa kyaffe, wabula mulimu gwokka gw’amaanyi ga Katonda ku lw’abo abamusanyusa. Emmeeme yaffe ejja kutuuka mu bwangu ku kwagala kuno okutuukiridde, nga tekyanyigirizibwa mugugu wadde okukemebwa kw’omubiri guno; olwo ejja kubuuka nga teriiko kigisibye eri essanyu lyayo mu Mukama. Naye tusaanidde okubuusabuusa nti emmeeme z’abajulizi abatukuvu, nga tezinnava mu mibiri gyazo egyawangula, zaalegako, waakiri mu kigero ekitono, ku ssanyu lino? Kino tukimanyi ddala, nti okwagala okutagerageranyizika kwajjuza era kwasikiriza emmeeme zaabwe, okubawa amaanyi okuwaayo obulamu bwabwe n’okugumiikiriza ebibonyoobonyo bye baabonyaabonyezebwa. Wabula essanyu ly’obuwanguzi bwabwe lirina okuba nga lyakendeezebwako olw’ekyo.

fields.title: Okwagala Okutuukiridde Oluvannyuma lw’Okuzuukira
fields.body_html:
KALE tuyinza kukkiriza ki ku mmeeme ezimaze okusumululwa okuva mu mugugu gw’omubiri? Nzikiriza nti zinnyikiddwa ddala mu buziba obutagerageranyizika obw’ekitangaala eky’olubeerera, n’obw’olubeerera obumasamasa. Naye obanga, nga bwe tutayinza kukyegaana, zikyegomba era zisuubira okuddamu okwegatta n’emibiri gye zaabeerangamu, kyeyoleka nti tezinnakyusibwa ddala, wabula nti emibiri gyazo gikyalina omugabo mu zo, newaakubadde nga guyinza okuba omutono ennyo. Era, okutuusa okufa lwe kulimirwa ddala mu buwanguzi, okutuusa ekitiibwa eky’olubeerera lwe kiribuna buli nsonda ey’obwakabaka bw’ekiro, n’okumasamasa kw’ekitangaala eky’omu ggulu ne kwakira ne mu mibiri gyaffe, okutuusa olwo emmeeme zaffe tezisobola n’akatono kwesuula mu Katonda, n’okwewaayo ddala gy’ali. Okutuusa olwo enjegere z’omubiri zikyazikugira, ne bwe kiba kyokka olw’okwagala okw’obutonde kwe zitalina kwagala wadde maanyi kukuleka; era, okutuusa emibiri gyaffe lwe girizzibwawo, emmeeme zaffe tezisobola n’akatono kumirwa mu Katonda, kwe kutuukirira kwazo okujjuvu. Singa okwegatta naye kwali kuyinza okutuukirizibwa emmeeme yokka, teyandyegombye nate mubiri; naye emmeeme bw’eva mu mubiri, kiba kugobolola, era kugobolola okusingawo bw’eddamu okwegatta nagwo. Era ku nkomerero, “Okufa kw’abatukuvu ba Mukama kwa muwendo nnyo eri Mukama.” Obanga okufa kuyinza okutenderezebwa bwe kutyo, obulamu buliba butya? obulamu obwo! Emmeeme eyinza bulungi okulowooza nti ejja kufuna okweyongera kw’ekitiibwa okuva mu mubiri gwayo, kubanga, newaakubadde nga gwali munafu era nga gwa kufa, gwayamba nnyo ku birungi byayo. “eri abo abaagala Katonda … ebintu byonna bibatuukako olw’obulungi;” era emmeeme eyagala Katonda egasibwa omubiri gwayo omwavu era omunafu, oba nga mulamu, oba nga mufu, oba nga muzuukifu — nga mulamu, olw’okubala nayo ebibala eby’okwenenya; nga mufu, olw’okuwummula okuva mu kutegana kwagwo; nga muzuukifu, byombi awamu ne bituuka ku kutuukirizibwa kw’essanyu lyonna. Kale kyeyoleka nti awatali mubiri emmeeme tetuukirizibwa; nga bwe kiri nti mu buli mbeera gwetaagisa nnyo olw’obulungi bwayo.

Kale omubiri, eri emmeeme, gwe munne omwesigwa; obanga mugugu, era guyamba; bwe gulekera awo okuyamba, gulekera awo n’okulemesa; bwe guddamu okuyamba, tegukyali mugugu. Embeera esooka ya kutegana, naye ya mugaso; ey’okubiri teriimu kukola, naye si ya kukoowa n’akamu; era ey’okusatu ya kitiibwa. Wulira Omugole omusajja mu Luyimba lwa Sulemaani bw’ayita emmeeme okuyingira mu mbeera zino essatu: “Abemikwano mulye munywe, munywere ddala, mmwe abaagalana.” Emmeeme z’ayita okulya ze ezo ezikyategana mu mibiri gyazo; ezo eziwummudde mu kufa, azikubiriza okunywa; ezo ezimaze okuddamu okwambazibwa, okunywera ddala; era, ng’aziyita abaagalwa be ennyo, alaga nti zijjudde okwagala: kubanga eri ezisooka agamba “abemikwano” kyokka; kubanga abo abakyategana wansi w’obuzito bw’omubiri ba muwendo gy’ali ng’okwagala kwe bamulina bwe kuli. Abo abasumuluddwa okuva mu mugugu gw’omubiri bamusinga okuba ab’omuwendo, olw’eddembe n’obujjuvu okwagala kwabwe bye kufunye. Naye, bwe bageraageranyizibwa n’abo bonna, abaagalwa be ennyo ddala be bo abaddamu okwambala ekyambalo eky’omubiri ogw’ekitiibwa, nga basikiddwa okwagala kwa Katonda mu ddembe ery’essanyu okuva mu buli kintu ekiyinza okubakululira wansi oba okulemesa okubuuka kwabwe okw’okulinnya waggulu. Tebasumululwa bwe batyo okutuusa nga batuukiriziddwa bwe batyo, kubanga mu mbeera esooka omubiri gukooya omwoyo ne gugukugira; mu ey’okubiri, omubiri kintu ekisuubirwa era ekyegombebwa ku lw’omuntu yennyini, ekirimu akabala k’okweyagala. Emmeeme ennyiikivu etandika okulya emmere, naye, woowe, “Mu ntuuyo zo mw’onoggyanga ekyokulya;” kubanga ebbanga lyonna lw’ekyali mu mubiri etambula lwa kukkiriza kwokka, okulina okukola olw’okwagala, kubanga okukkiriza awatali bikolwa kufu. Kale bino bye bikolwa ebiri emmere yaayo, ng’ekigambo kya Mukama bwe kiri: “Ekyokulya kyange kwe kukola eyantuma by’ayagala.” Bw’emala okweyambulamu omubiri ogw’okufa, elekera awo okulya emmere ey’ennaku, era, ng’ekijjulo bwe kiggwa, enywa nnyo wayini ow’okwagala; naye wayini ono tannaba mulongoofu nga tatabuddwamu, kubanga, ng’Omugole omusajja bw’agamba mu Luyimba lwa Sulemaani, “Nywedde wayini wange n’amata gange,” kubanga ku wayini ow’okwagala kwa Katonda emmeeme etabulamu amata; kwe kugamba okwegomba okuddamu okwegatta n’omubiri gwayo gw’eyagala n’obugonvu bw’okwagala okw’obutonde. Ewulira dda amaanyi g’okwagala okw’obwakatonda kw’enywa, naye tekunnagisikiriza ddala; okutabulwamu amata kukyakukkakkanya. Okutamiira kutabula omwoyo ne gweerabira gwokka; naye eyo si ye mbeera y’emmeeme ekyayaayaanira omubiri gwayo ogugenda okuzuukira. Teyeerabira ddala gyokka. Naye bw’eriddamu okufuna ekintu kino kyokka ekiburawo, kiki ekiyinza okugiziyiza okwesuula ddala mu Katonda, n’ebuza n’okufaanana kwayo yokka, olw’okufuulibwa okufaanana ye? Nga tewakyali kiziyiza, eyinza okuyimusa ku mimwa gyayo ekikompe eky’amagezi ekyo kye kyawandiikibwako nti: “ekikompe kyange kiyiwa;” era ani ayinza okwewuunya nti esikiddwa ebingi ebijjuza ennyumba ya Katonda; nga teriiko kweraliikirira kwonna, enywa, mu Bwakabaka bwa Kitaffe, wayini w’Omwana, omulongoofu era omuggya, mu bukkakkamu era okumala ekiseera ekiwanvu.

Amagezi ge gategeka embaga eno ey’emirundi esatu, emmere yonna mw’eri okwagala. Gawa emmere abo abakyalina okutegana, wayini abo abamaze okuwummula okunywa; era ne gatamiiza abo abagenze mu bwakabaka obw’omu ggulu. Abagenyi baago bwe bamala okulya, gabaweereza wayini. Ebbanga lyonna lye tutegana mu bulamu buno, nga twetisse omubiri ogufa, tulina okulya emmere okutegana kwaffe gye kutufunidde, tulina okulya nga tutegana n’okugimira; naye, tetunnaba kussa mukka gwaffe ogusembayo, ne tutandika okunywa mu bulamu bwaffe obw’omwoyo, nga tufuna ekikompe, era nga tunywa mu kuwummula okw’essanyu. Byonna bwe bimala okutuukirizibwa, omubiri ne guzuukizibwa mu bulamu ne guzzibwa eri emmeeme, binywa okutuusa okunywera ddala okuva mu kikompe ekitaggwaamu. Eno y’amakulu g’ebigambo bino: “Abemikwano mulye munywe, munywere ddala, mmwe abaagalana.” Mu bulamu buno, mulye; oluvannyuma lw’okufa mulinywa; mu bwakabaka bw’okuzuukira mulinywera ddala; mmwe be nnyinza bulungi okuyita abaagalwa bange ennyo. Tebali bwe batyo ddala abo abakkirizibwa ku mbaga ey’obugole ey’Omwana gw’Endiga, abatuula ku mmeeza ye, nga balya era nga banywa mu bwakabaka bwe, Kristo bw’alimala okukola byonna “alyoke yeefunire Ekkanisa ey’ekitiibwa, eteriiko bbala wadde akamogo oba ekintu kyonna ekikyamu”? Olwo lw’alinywesa abaagalwa be ennyo, ng’abafukira “ebyokunywa by’omugga gwo ogwesiimisa;” kubanga Omugole omusajja bw’aliwambaatira Omugole mu kwagala kwe okulongoofu, omugga gw’essanyu gulisanyusa Ekibuga kya Katonda, kye ntegeera okuba si kirala wabula Omwana wa Katonda, oyo “atuuze abaddu abo ku mmeeza abagabule.” Bw’atyo bwe yasuubiza nti abatuukirivu banaalya embaga, “basanyuke bajagulize mu maaso ga Katonda, nga bajjudde essanyu.” Okuva eyo we muva okukkuta okutakkusa; ebbugumu eritakkuta, naye eriteefu ennyo era eririmu emirembe; okwegomba okw’olubeerera era okutagerageranyizika okw’okubeera n’ekintu, okutava mu bwetaavu bwonna; okunywera ddala okwo okutaliimu kuyitiridde, okuva mu kunyumirwa, si wayini, wabula Katonda n’Amazima ge. Emmeeme etuuse emirembe gyonna ku mutendera ogw’okuna ogw’okwagala, bw’eyagala Katonda yekka, era n’emwagala okusinga byonna; bw’eyagala awatali kunoonya magoba, ku lulwe yekka; ne kiba nti ye mpeera yaayo, empeera ey’olubeerera ey’abo abamwagala, era abalimwagala emirembe gyonna.
